title: Judaism: Overview — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Judaism is the ancient monotheistic faith of the Jewish people, centered on covenant with one God. The Pew Research Center estimated about 14 million Jews worldwide, about two-tenths of one percent of humanity. This overview edition presents Judaism: Overview within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
